title: What can we do with a hacked supercar?

author: Cybernews
description:
Cybernews meets security researcher Sam Curry and automotive hacker Busescanfly to test how hackable modern cars really are. From the CAN bus and diagnostic ports to cloud-based exploits, we uncover how connected cars can be tracked, unlocked, and controlled — showing that the real danger isn’t just hardware, but the software and APIs behind it.

DISCLAIMER:
This video shows independent testing conducted in a controlled environment to raise awareness about vehicle cybersecurity. Cybernews does not encourage or support hacking, tampering or unauthorized access to vehicles or any electronic systems. Recreating anything shown or discussed herein can be dangerous and illegal. Some software names, steps, and technical details were removed or redacted to prevent misuse and protect public safety. The results reflect limited testing at the time of filming and may not reflect current or future behavior of the system demonstrated.
